question: Which of the following nations won the third blind cricket World Cup T20 championship?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__India__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India won the Blind T20 Cricket World Cup in 2017 against Pakistan.**
 
• **The final match was held at the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru, India.**
 
• On February 12, 2017, India successfully chased down the target set by Pakistan, marking a significant victory.
 
• The final was a thriller game. Indian team chased down the target score in the very last over of the match.
 
• **Prakash Jayaramaiah of the Indian team played a crucial role in the victory with his unbeaten 99 runs.**
 
• This was the second edition of the Blind Cricket World Cup, and with this game, India retained their title.
